_camera_view_limitation: Only TWO distinct camera views exist among eligible sources, not three. Uncropped full-frame background correlation: view A {0_tr1,0_tr2,0_tr16,0_tr48,0_tr61,0_tr109,0_tr119} mutual r 0.74-0.99; view B {0_tr124,0_tr125,0_tr135,0_tr143} mutual r 0.92-0.98; between views r 0.06-0.19. 0_tr16 and 0_tr48 are therefore the SAME camera view (r 0.929) from different recordings and different recording groups. The third source supplies a different walking direction, which the brief allows as the alternative, and NOT a third view. 0_tr2 was dropped for 0_tr48 only because 0_tr48 walks the other way.
_an_earlier_scan_was_wrong: A first scan appeared to find a third camera family at r~0.40. It compared uncropped candidates against a cropped reference, so it was not like for like. Repeated correctly, there are two views. The wrong number is recorded here rather than quietly dropped.
_lane_measure: Lane = dense green mask, G - max(R,B) > 15 kept only where >=50% of a 15x15 neighbourhood is green. The plain per-pixel test leaves speckle across the frame and made the first selection job's distances meaningless (it reported lane_x 0-1919 and dist_min near 0).
_classifier_guidance: disabled in every run; no gradients, no training

settings.negative_prompt: inconsistent motion, blurry motion, worse quality, degenerate outputs, deformed outputs, camera movement, scene change
settings._identical_within_each_pair: source clip, seed, scheduler, dtype, prompt, negative prompt, strength, guidance, steps, resolution, frame count. The generator is re-seeded from the same value immediately before each call, so the initial noise is identical too.
